preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.
Length of binary strings S and P is between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, len(S) == len(P) == N
preconditions.description: Lengths of S and P are equal to N.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output is either 'YES' or 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output for each test case is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: if S can be converted to P using the allowed operations, output 'YES'
postconditions.description: If S can be converted to P using the allowed operations, output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: if S cannot be converted to P using the allowed operations, output 'NO'
postconditions.description: If S cannot be converted to P using the allowed operations, output 'NO'.
